description: This file implements the front-end of a Tic Tac Toe game using React components, managing game state, user interactions, and AI move logic.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks the current game board for a winner or draw based on predefined winning line combinations.

methods.name: getAvailableMoves
methods.description: Returns a list of indices for empty cells on the board.

methods.name: computeAIMove
methods.description: Determines the AI's next move based on simple heuristics: win, block, take center, take corner, or random.
